name: Cariprazine
summary: Cariprazine, sold under the brand name Vraylar among others, is an atypical antipsychotic developed by Gedeon Richter, which is used in the treatment of schizophrenia and bipolar disorder. It is also prescribed as an add-on treatment for bipolar depression and major depressive disorder. Cariprazine acts primarily as a D3 and D2 receptor partial agonist, with a preference for the D3 receptor.

pharmacology.text: Unlike many antipsychotics that are D2 and 5-HT2A receptor antagonists, cariprazine is a D2 and D3 partial agonist. It also has a higher affinity for D3 receptors. The D2 and D3 receptors are important targets for the treatment of schizophrenia, because the overstimulation of dopamine receptors has been implicated as a possible cause of schizophrenia.

body.says: 2–4 days for parent drug, and 1–3 weeks for active metabolites
Liver via CYP3A4 and to a lesser extent CYP2D6

uses.text: Cariprazine is used to treat patients with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder and manic, depressive, or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder. In the US, it is approved for schizophrenia in adults, acute treatment of manic or mixed episodes associated with bipolar I disorder in adults and treatment of depressive episodes associated with bipolar I disorder (bipolar depression).

sideEffects.text: The most prevalent side effects include nausea, mild sedation, fatigue, diabetes regardless of weight changes, and dizziness.

summaryZh: 卡利拉嗪是一種口服的非典型抗精神病藥物，用於治療精神分裂症和躁鬱症。英國的威爾斯地區不建議使用。
summaryZhHans: 卡利拉嗪是一种口服的非典型抗精神病药物，用于治疗精神分裂症和躁郁症。英国的威尔士地区不建议使用。

fact.en: Cariprazine was developed by the Hungarian drug company Gedeon Richter. Unlike most antipsychotics it binds more tightly to the dopamine D3 receptor than to D2, and the body turns it into active breakdown products that linger for a long time.
fact.zh: 卡利拉嗪由匈牙利藥廠吉瑞（Gedeon Richter）研發。和大多數抗精神病藥不同，它與多巴胺 D3 受體的結合比 D2 更緊密，而且身體會把它轉化成作用持久的活性代謝物。
fact.zhHans: 卡利拉嗪由匈牙利药厂吉瑞（Gedeon Richter）研发。和大多数抗精神病药不同，它与多巴胺 D3 受体的结合比 D2 更紧密，而且身体会把它转化成作用持久的活性代谢物。
